what: Ada signs a creator's seat row whose seats is the 16-character TEXT OPENSEAT-OPENSEA, not a byte string: the row hashes to its session, so it is that session's creator's seat row. Bo asks for the open seat and moves (B); Ada confirms him and moves (A). A creator's seat row whose roster is not valid makes its session void: nobody holds a seat, nothing in it is admitted, nothing closes it, and nothing is reported, since nobody signed twice; no reader throws (R14, R20; review 10, A01).
